data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Couchbase Lite, an embedded NoSQL document database with sync support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to open, query, and modify Couchbase Lite databases on mobile and desktop. Includes observable change notifications and built‑in data synchronization capabilities.
use_when: You need a full‑featured offline‑first NoSQL database with query and sync support across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
You want a single library that handles documents, full‑text search, and live queries without writing platform‑specific code.
avoid_when: You only need simple key‑value storage or a lightweight SQLite wrapper.
App size or native binary size must be minimal.
You require an officially supported Couchbase product.
strengths: Rich query language (SQL++, QueryBuilder) and full‑text search
Built‑in change listeners and data sync
weaknesses: Large native binaries increase app size
Not an official Couchbase product (may affect support)
Complexity compared to simple key‑value stores
data.setup_notes: Compiles native Couchbase Lite libraries; ensure Android API 34 or higher and iOS/macOS native setup as per documentation.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight SQLite wrapper for simple relational storage.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: Type‑safe SQLite with code generation and reactive queries.

alternatives.name: sqlite3
alternatives.why_pick_it: Direct low‑level SQLite access without Flutter‑specific abstractions.
